title: DispatchResult
description: Structured output every headless sub-agent dispatch must return. Enforced via `claude -p ... --output-format json --json-schema orchestration/schemas/dispatch-result.json`. The orchestrator records one of these per dispatch in docs/dispatch-logs/YYYY-MM-DD.json.

ticket.description: Ticket ID the dispatch worked on (PM-tool ID or backlog EPIC-XX-TYY).

persona.description: Persona slug from orchestration/graph.yaml that executed the work.

outcome.description: completed = PR open; blocked = dependency surfaced mid-work; gate_failed = a declared gate is red and retries are exhausted; budget_exceeded = halted at the spend/time cap; failed = anything else.

pr_url.description: URL of the opened PR. Required when outcome is completed.

branch.description: Branch pushed to origin, if any.

blocked_on.description: Ticket IDs or resource names the work is blocked on (outcome=blocked).

gate_results.description: Result of each declared gate the sub-agent ran locally before pushing.

followups.description: Follow-up work discovered but out of scope — one line each; the orchestrator files tickets.

notes.description: One short paragraph max. Raw data over narrative — the dispatch log is the story.
